Letting.title: Letting
Letting.rentIncreaseNotice: Rent increases are checked arithmetically only. Sending stays locked until release gate G3 and a documented legal review.

Receivables.title: Receivables
Receivables.notice: Preview first, then post. Prorated amounts and other intervals stay manual. Postings are not the leading bookkeeping until release gate G1.
Receivables.confirmPost: Post receivables now? Posted receivables are only corrected by reversal.

Bank.title: Bank
Bank.notice: Matches are proposals. An IBAN alone does not prove the debtor. Booking only after confirmation; not the leading bookkeeping until release gate G1.
Bank.confirmBook: Match payment of {amount} to this open item and book?

Payments.title: Payment orders
Payments.notice: Approval by two different people. Any change voids approvals. The payment file is only created with release gate G2; export or submission never counts as payment.

Dunning.title: Dunning
Dunning.notice: Dunning runs start as preview. A second person must approve. Only the leading system may dun; while Immoware24 leads, all cases are excluded.
Dunning.feesLocked: A dunning fee or statutory interest only applies once the operator has entered an amount, or a Basiszinssatz, for that level (operator decision 25.09.2026, V7 partly decided). Without a value the item stays 0.00 EUR.
Dunning.confirmApprove: Approve this dunning run now? Approval cannot be undone.
Dunning.mahnbescheidHint: Preparation only, for review by a lawyer. The platform never files this itself.
Dunning.mahnbescheidOnlyHighest: Only possible on the highest configured level.
Dunning.settingsTitle: Dunning levels, fees and statutory interest
Dunning.settingsNotice: Amounts and the base rate are a commercial setting, not a legal release. The fee amount and the contractual basis for charging it to the community are still to be reviewed legally.
Dunning.presetsLoaded: Suggested values loaded. Please enter amounts and the base rate yourself.
Dunning.interestEnabledHint: Only selectable once a base rate is entered.
Dunning.interestBaseRate: Base rate (%, maintained by the operator, changes twice a year)

Billing.title: Operating cost statement
Billing.notice: Cost items only with a basis. Heating costs come from the metering statement. Internal approval by a second person; issuing to tenants is locked until release gate G3.

Platform.title: Platform
Platform.notice: Read only view for platform administrators. Prices and licences are maintained via the API. Release gates are neither opened nor changed here; G5 evidence is kept manually.

Invoices.title: Incoming invoices
Invoices.notice: Automatic checks only give hints. Invoice release, posting and payment release are separate; a second person releases, only for the reviewed version.
Invoices.confirmIban: Confirm the changed IBAN after calling the issuer back?
Invoices.confirmPost: Post the invoice now? Corrections only by reversal.

Levy.wording: The special levy for {purpose} is resolved as distributed.
Levy.confirmApply: Apply the instalments as contract payments now?
Levy.amendNote: Creates a new version. The applied version stays unchanged; the difference per unit becomes an additional charge or credit from the chosen month.

RentLaw.title: Rent law: rule set
RentLaw.notice: Values apply to automatic checks only after release. Release needs a value and a source checked against the statute; any change resets the rule to draft. The system does not replace a legal review of the individual case.

area.none: No areas recorded. Without an entry the released rule value applies.

MailSettings.title: Mailboxes
MailSettings.intro: Google OAuth client of the tenant, connected mailboxes, default mailbox and per user access. Mailboxes are read only; every new mail opens a ticket.
MailSettings.oauthHint: Create a web application OAuth client in the Google Cloud Console, add the redirect URI below and enable the Gmail API. The secret is stored encrypted and never shown.
MailSettings.mailboxesHint: Connect with Google opens the Google sign in. After consent the mailbox appears here and is fetched every two minutes.
MailSettings.removeConfirm: Remove mailbox {address}? Ingested mails and tickets are kept.
MailSettings.defaultHint: Every user of the tenant sees a default mailbox, including newly created ones.
MailSettings.calendarHint: This mailbox's appointments appear in the calendar. When enabling it the first time, reconnect with Google so the calendar permission is granted.
MailSettings.invoiceForwardingHint: Invoices addressed to the company itself (not property related) are forwarded to the configured address when the sender is on the allowlist and no property reference is found. Every other detected invoice appears as a suggestion in the mail view.
MailSettings.invoiceForwardingAllowlistHint: Confirming a suggestion twice adds the sender to the learning list automatically.
MailSettings.forwardInvoiceConfirm: Forward this invoice to the configured address?

smsGateway.title: SMS gateway
smsGateway.intro: Vendor neutral HTTP gateway for SMS escalations to the on-call person. Nothing is sent unless enabled. Placeholders of the JSON template:
smsGateway.authHeaderSet: A value is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
smsGateway.testOk: The gateway accepted the test message.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.intro: WhatsApp Business Platform (Meta Cloud API). Only templates approved by Meta are sent, never free text: a business initiated message outside WhatsApp's 24 hour service window is only possible as a template message.
whatsapp.accessTokenSet: A value is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
whatsapp.templatesHint: Must match the template name approved at Meta exactly.
whatsapp.smsFallback: Use SMS as fallback when WhatsApp fails
whatsapp.testOk: The Cloud API accepted the test message.

Version.title: Version history
Version.scheme: Scheme: first digit for major rebuilds, second for new features, third for small fixes.

BankSettings.title: Bank (finAPI)
BankSettings.intro: Credentials for the read-only online banking connection via finAPI. No bank PIN or TAN: login and account authorization only happen in the bank's own WebForm.
BankSettings.description: Client ID, client secret and optional mandator ID of this tenant's finAPI access.
BankSettings.autoFetchHint: Fetches transactions of assigned accounts once a day automatically (default: off). A manual "Fetch transactions" click is independent of this.

BankConnections.title: Bank connections
BankConnections.intro: Connect bank accounts via finAPI and link them permanently to a ledger or property. Read only: no transfers, no automatic posting.
BankConnections.notConfigured: Bank connection not yet configured. Set up credentials under Settings, Bank.
BankConnections.queued: Fetch queued, processing in the background.
BankConnections.webFormHint: Complete bank authorization in the new window, then click Check.
BankConnections.fetchRangeHint: Date range optional; without it, the provider delivers what it has.
BankConnections.fetchBank: Fetch transactions of every assigned account
BankConnections.wizardStep1: 1. Search the bank and start the authorization
BankConnections.wizardStep2: 2. Finish the authorization in the new window, then check

DmsSettings.title: DMS connection
DmsSettings.intro: Connection between the CRM and document management. Immoware24 remains the master of record.
DmsSettings.googleDriveHint: Google Drive is configured through this form. Create an OAuth client in the Google Cloud Console, enable the Drive API, generate a refresh token once via OAuth Playground or gcloud.
DmsSettings.tokenStored: Token stored, enter a new one to change it
DmsSettings.tokenHint: The token is write only and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored token.
DmsSettings.rootFolderIdHint: The ID from the folder's Drive URL.
DmsSettings.secretHint: The client secret and refresh token are write only and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored credentials.
DmsSettings.secretPairRequired: Enter the client secret and refresh token together.
DmsSettings.connectGoogleDriveHint: Connects the Google account via OAuth; client secret and refresh token are stored automatically.
DmsSettings.oauthClientMissingHint: First configure the OAuth client under Settings, Mailboxes.
DmsSettings.connectedNeedsRootFolder: Google account {account} connected. Enter the root folder ID and save to activate the connection.
DmsSettings.rootFolderIdBeforeConnectHint: Save this before connecting so the connection can activate right after the OAuth flow.
